stories.title: ICJ report sees 'judicial capture' in Pakistan after 26th, 27th Constitutional Amendments
stories.brief: A report released by the International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) on Wednesday said that the 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments led to a “systemic judicial capture” in Pakistan.

stories.title: Pakistan conducts successful launch of Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile: ISPR
stories.brief: The Pakistan Army on Wednesday successfully launched the Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile, according to the military’s media wing. It added that the missile would “significantly enhance the operational flexibility and strike range of the Pakistan Army’s Rocket Force Command, further strengthening the country’s overall conventional deterrence and defence posture”.

stories.title: ICJ report deplores judicial independence in Pakistan after 26th, 27th Constitutional Amendments
stories.brief: A report released by the International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) on Wednesday deplored the state of judicial independence in Pakistan after the passage of the 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments. The amendment also introduced key changes to the judicial appointment process, specifically in Article 175-A.

stories.title: ASEAN sec gen to visit Pakistan for first time in over two decades from Nov 18 to 20: FO
stories.brief: Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Secretary General Dr Kao Kim Hourn will undertake a working visit to Pakistan from November 18 to 20 at the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, the Foreign Office (FO) said on Wednesday.

stories.title: Military successfully tests launch of Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile
stories.brief: Pakistan successfully test-fired the Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile, marking another “significant milestone” in the country's efforts to strengthen its defence capabilities, the military's media wing said on Wednesday. Pakistan Army today conducted a successful launch of Fatah-3 Supersonic Cruise Missile, marking another significant milestone in the advancement of national defence capabilities, according to ISPR.

stories.title: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'
stories.brief: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.

stories.title: AI giant Anthropic valued at up to $1.5tn ahead of stock market debut
stories.brief: Anthropic started just five years ago and is now one of the biggest names in artificial intelligence.

stories.title: The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires

stories.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 hits record one light-day distance, 50 years after launch
stories.brief: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth, marking a historic milestone nearly 50 years after its 1977 launch.

stories.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways
stories.brief: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.

stories.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
stories.brief: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

stories.title: Josh Kerr: The Man Behind the Sunglasses
stories.brief: An in depth look at the man behind the athlete.

stories.title: 'Come to your senses': Bilawal advises govt to 'calm down' and hold a 'debate you started' on provinces
stories.brief: The remarks come after Defence Minister Khawaja Asif hit back at Bilawal earlier in the day over his criticism of the government and calls for a "political reset", questioning his moral standing to lecture others while pointing to the PPP's 18-year rule in Sindh.

stories.title: Pakistan takes pride in safeguarding its invaluable Gandhara heritage: culture minister
stories.brief: Foreign Secretary Ambassador Asim Iftikhar Ahmad welcomed the international delegates and Buddhist monastics, highlighting Gandhara's significance as a shared heritage of humanity and a bridge between civilisations. The monastics also highlighted the importance of recognising Gandhara as a shared heritage and improving facilities for Buddhist pilgrims, scholars and religious visitors.

stories.title: Josh Kerr: The making of the man behind the shades
stories.brief: The mile world record holder talks about disguising alcohol-free cider, entering races under a false name and his granny keeping him humble.

stories.title: Xi, Trump, Putin exchange first greetings in China
stories.brief: United States President Donald Trump, China’s Xi Jinping and Russia’s Vladimir Putin exchanged first greetings in China on Wednesday, a day before their first formal trilateral meeting. President Trump joins world leaders for a Family Photo at the APEC gathering in China, greeting Chinese President Xi Jinping and other leaders before they pose together.

stories.title: Voyager 1 spacecraft reaches one light-day milestone
stories.brief: NASA's Voyager 1 probe, which has been travelling through space for nearly 50 years, hit a milestone distance of one light-day away from Earth on Wednesday.

stories.title: GTA 6 dazzles gamers in Australia with ‘fully lived-in, breathable world’
stories.brief: And the reviews, mere hours into release, reflect universal acclaim. The game has already vaulted to the top spot on Metacritic’s list of the best games of all time, sitting above 1998’s The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time with an unprecedented 99/100 score.

stories.title: Why has Waymo pulled all its driverless cars from US freeways?
stories.brief: The vehicles currently operate in 15 US cities, though freeway rides are only offered in a handful, including San Francisco and Los Angeles.

stories.title: Can Anthropic's record-breaking IPO stop the AI bubble bursting?
stories.brief: Anthropic's hotly anticipated IPO is expected to put it in the top 10 most valuable US companies, but the future is uncertain.
